Banner_NewVersion: AMM v{0} is available (source: {1})  ·  current v{2}
Banner_Portable: You are running the portable build: the zip will be downloaded and extracted over the current files, then AMM restarts automatically.
Banner_Installed: You are running the installed build: the installer will be downloaded and opened. Follow its steps (AMM reopens automatically when done).
Settings_ThemeHint: ‘Follow system’ reads the Windows light/dark setting and switches with it in real time.
Settings_LanguageHint: Choose the interface language. ‘Follow system’ uses the Windows display language. Changes apply instantly — no restart needed.
Settings_GamePathPlaceholder: e.g. D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\A Dance of Fire and Ice
Settings_ApiKey: API key (create it on the site's profile page)
Settings_SiteHint: You can point this at any site that implements the same API (see docs/RESOURCE-SITE-API.md). The API key is stored locally only; the public build ships without one.
Settings_CheckStartup: Check for updates when AMM starts
Settings_CheckGitHub: Also check GitHub (authors usually publish there first)
Settings_UpdateHint: Both sources are checked and the higher version wins (the mod site is preferred on a tie). GitHub may be unreachable — failures are ignored silently and only the mod site is used. Turning this off makes checks faster and quieter.
Settings_UpdateNowTip: Download and replace with the new version automatically (portable: extract & overwrite; installed: runs the installer)
